description: Archipelago implementation for Super Mario Land.

v0.0.1.description:
The game should be playable, but there are some things to note:

-The goal condition (Completing 4-3) currently does not work, this will be fixed in the next release

-Entering a level that is not unlocked will game over - This is intended although I plan change this in the future and have the game skip over locked levels and load the next unlocked one

-The "Coin" item currently does nothing, this will be fixed in the next release
v0.0.1.title: Mario Land AP v0.0.1

v0.0.2.description:
Game should be fully working now
-Level select is unlocked from the start
-Every level after 1-1 is locked behind an item (Entering a locked level will trigger a game over
-Completing a level sends a check
-The goal condition is beating 4-3 and saving daisy

---
Known Issues:
-Universal Tracker always incorrectly shows "Go Mode"
-Locked levels are able to be entered and completed
-Levels will sometimes be skipped after completing a level
-2-3 will always game over, even if it is unlocked
v0.0.2.title: Mario Land AP v0.0.2

v0.0.3.description:
Bug Fixes
-Fixed a major issue with all levels except 2-3 being open from the start, all levels should now be properly locked and unlocked
-Removed some unfinished level skipping code that was causing some issues
v0.0.3.title: Mario Land AP v0.0.3

v0.1.0.description:
Additions:
-Every Secret Area has been added as a check
-This adds 18 new checks putting the total up to 30

Changes:
-The Level Select will now attempt to skip over locked levels, this is to make it easier to figure out what levels are unlocked without needing a tracker
-When entering a locked level, the life count will be set to 0 to speed up the game over
v0.1.0.title: Mario Land AP v0.1.0
